goal: Reduce false graph-issue claims while preserving useful candidates and verification honesty.
leading: held-out graph candidates receiving multi-lane verdicts
budget: one baseline, up to two bounded instruction patches, one held-out repository smoke
guardrails: test success follows process exit status
the eval harness is unchanged during the experiment
heldOut: packages/octocode/src graph question selected before the instruction patch and not used to author cases
decisionRule: ACCEPT only if case pass rate reaches 1.0, guardrails hold, and the held-out smoke produces evidence-complete verdicts.
